verdict.rationale: Datadog ships an official CLI, datadog-ci, built for CI pipelines, plus a documented API reference and CI Visibility, so headless and CI-driven automation is clearly supported. The evidence is mostly titles and links, with little detail on how the workflows run. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 at the guessed paths, which shows no published spec there but does not contradict API availability. Missing for 10: detailed docs on CLI/CI usage and auth for headless runs, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
